title: Peruvian Chicken Soup
description: A flavorful and comforting Peruvian chicken soup made with nimble chicken, aromatic broth, and a touch of spice.
instructions: Heat the Peruvian broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the aji amarillo pepper and cumin, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
